==============================================================================
GOVERNMENT GUIDELINE DOCUMENT
SCHEME: Atal Pension Yojana
SCHEME ID: APY-2023
LEVEL: CENTRAL   |   STATE: All India
CATEGORY: PENSION
==============================================================================

1. OBJECTIVE
   A guaranteed pension scheme for unorganised sector workers, providing a fixed monthly pension between Rs. 1000 and Rs. 5000 after the age of 60, depending on the contribution chosen.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
   [APY-C1] (MANDATORY) The applicant must be 18 years of age or older.
   [APY-C2] (MANDATORY) The applicant must be 40 years of age or younger.
   [APY-C3] (MANDATORY) The applicant must not be an income tax payer.

3. ENTITLEMENT / BENEFIT RULES
   [APY-E1] The subscriber receives a guaranteed minimum monthly pension of Rs. 1000 after the age of 60.

4. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
   [APY-D1] (MANDATORY) Aadhaar Card
   [APY-D2] (MANDATORY) Bank Account Passbook
   [APY-D3] (MANDATORY) Mobile Number

5. APPLICATION & GRIEVANCE / APPEAL HIERARCHY
   [APY-APL1] Level 1: Bank Nodal Officer - within 30 days. First grievance at the bank.
   [APY-APL2] Level 2: PFRDA Grievance Redressal Cell - within 60 days. Escalation to the pension regulator.
   [APY-APL3] Level 3: Pension Ombudsman - within 90 days. Final grievance before the Pension Ombudsman.

==============================================================================
END OF GUIDELINE DOCUMENT

GOVERNMENT GUIDELINE DOCUMENT
SCHEME: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
SCHEME ID: DDUGKY-2023
LEVEL: CENTRAL   |   STATE: All India
CATEGORY: SKILL
==============================================================================

1. OBJECTIVE
   A placement-linked skill development programme for rural poor youth that provides free training in employable trades and guarantees placement in wage employment or self-employment.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
   [DDUGKY-C1] (MANDATORY) The applicant must live in a rural area.
   [DDUGKY-C2] (MANDATORY) The applicant must be 35 years of age or younger.

3. ENTITLEMENT / BENEFIT RULES
   [DDUGKY-E1] Eligible rural youth receive free skill training with a guaranteed placement; there is no direct cash benefit.

4. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
   [DDUGKY-D1] (MANDATORY) Aadhaar Card
   [DDUGKY-D2] (MANDATORY) Age Proof
   [DDUGKY-D3] (MANDATORY) Bank Account Passbook

5. APPLICATION & GRIEVANCE / APPEAL HIERARCHY
   [DDUGKY-APL1] Level 1: Block Programme Manager - within 30 days. First grievance at the block level.
   [DDUGKY-APL2] Level 2: District Programme Manager - within 60 days. Escalation at district level.
   [DDUGKY-APL3] Level 3: State Programme Director - within 90 days. Final grievance at state level.

==============================================================================
END OF GUIDELINE DOCUMENT

GOVERNMENT GUIDELINE DOCUMENT
SCHEME: eShram (National Database of Unorganised Workers)
SCHEME ID: ESRAM-2023
LEVEL: CENTRAL   |   STATE: All India
CATEGORY: LABOUR
==============================================================================

1. OBJECTIVE
   A national registry of unorganised workers, including migrant and gig workers, that issues an eShram card and links workers to social security and welfare benefits.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
   [ESRAM-C1] (MANDATORY) The applicant must be 16 years of age or older.
   [ESRAM-C2] (MANDATORY) The applicant must be 59 years of age or younger.

3. ENTITLEMENT / BENEFIT RULES
   [ESRAM-E1] Registered workers receive an eShram card that gives access to social security and welfare schemes; there is no direct cash benefit.

4. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
   [ESRAM-D1] (MANDATORY) Aadhaar Card
   [ESRAM-D2] (MANDATORY) Bank Account Passbook
   [ESRAM-D3] (MANDATORY) Mobile Number

5. APPLICATION & GRIEVANCE / APPEAL HIERARCHY
   [ESRAM-APL1] Level 1: eShram Helpdesk - within 30 days. First grievance at the eShram helpdesk.
   [ESRAM-APL2] Level 2: State Labour Commissioner - within 60 days. Escalation at state level.
   [ESRAM-APL3] Level 3: Ministry of Labour and Employment - within 90 days. Final grievance at the Ministry.

==============================================================================
END OF GUIDELINE DOCUMENT

==============================================================================
GOVERNMENT GUIDELINE DOCUMENT
SCHEME: Integrated Child Development Services
SCHEME ID: ICDS-2023
LEVEL: CENTRAL   |   STATE: All India
CATEGORY: NUTRITION
==============================================================================

1. OBJECTIVE
   An early childhood care and development programme delivered through Anganwadi centres, providing supplementary nutrition, immunisation, health check-ups, referral services and pre-school education to children below six years and to mothers.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
   [ICDS-C1] (MANDATORY) The child must be 6 years of age or younger.

3. ENTITLEMENT / BENEFIT RULES
   [ICDS-E1] Eligible children and mothers receive supplementary nutrition and pre-school services free of cost at the Anganwadi centre; there is no cash benefit.

4. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
   [ICDS-D1] (MANDATORY) Aadhaar Card of Child
   [ICDS-D2] (MANDATORY) Immunization Card
   [ICDS-D3] (MANDATORY) Address Proof

5. APPLICATION & GRIEVANCE / APPEAL HIERARCHY
   [ICDS-APL1] Level 1: Anganwadi Worker - within 15 days. First grievance at the centre level.
   [ICDS-APL2] Level 2: Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) - within 30 days. Escalation at block level.
   [ICDS-APL3] Level 3: District Programme Officer - within 60 days. Final grievance at district level.

==============================================================================
END OF GUIDELINE DOCUMENT

GOVERNMENT GUIDELINE DOCUMENT
SCHEME: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
SCHEME ID: IGNDPS-2023
LEVEL: CENTRAL   |   STATE: All India
CATEGORY: PENSION
==============================================================================

1. OBJECTIVE
   Monthly pension for persons aged 18 years and above with severe or multiple disabilities (80% or more) belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
   [IGNDPS-C1] (MANDATORY) The applicant must be 18 years of age or older.
   [IGNDPS-C2] (MANDATORY) The applicant must be below 80 years of age.
   [IGNDPS-C3] (MANDATORY) The applicant must have a disability of 80% or more.
   [IGNDPS-C4] (MANDATORY) The applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household.

3. ENTITLEMENT / BENEFIT RULES
   [IGNDPS-E1] Eligible beneficiaries receive a pension of Rs. 300 per month.

4. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
   [IGNDPS-D1] (MANDATORY) Disability Certificate (80% or more)
   [IGNDPS-D2] (MANDATORY) Age Proof (Birth Certificate/School Certificate)
   [IGNDPS-D3] (MANDATORY) BPL Card
   [IGNDPS-D4] (MANDATORY) Aadhaar Card
   [IGNDPS-D5] (MANDATORY) Bank Account Passbook

5. APPLICATION & GRIEVANCE / APPEAL HIERARCHY
   [IGNDPS-APL1] Level 1: Block Development Officer (BDO) - within 30 days. First appeal at block level.
   [IGNDPS-APL2] Level 2: District Social Welfare Officer - within 60 days. Second appeal at district level.
   [IGNDPS-APL3] Level 3: State Social Welfare Commission - within 90 days. Final appeal at state level.

==============================================================================
END OF GUIDELINE DOCUMENT

GOVERNMENT GUIDELINE DOCUMENT
SCHEME: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
SCHEME ID: IGNOAPS-2023
LEVEL: CENTRAL   |   STATE: All India
CATEGORY: PENSION
==============================================================================

1. OBJECTIVE
   Monthly pension for persons aged 60 years and above belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households. Higher amount for persons aged 80 years and above.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
   [IGNOAPS-C1] (MANDATORY) The applicant must be 60 years of age or older.
   [IGNOAPS-C2] (MANDATORY) The applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household.

3. ENTITLEMENT / BENEFIT RULES
   [IGNOAPS-E1] Persons aged 80 years and above receive a pension of Rs. 500 per month.
   [IGNOAPS-E2] Persons aged 60 to 79 years receive a pension of Rs. 200 per month.

4. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
   [IGNOAPS-D1] (MANDATORY) Age Proof (Birth Certificate/School Certificate)
   [IGNOAPS-D2] (MANDATORY) BPL Card
   [IGNOAPS-D3] (MANDATORY) Aadhaar Card
   [IGNOAPS-D4] (MANDATORY) Bank Account Passbook

5. APPLICATION & GRIEVANCE / APPEAL HIERARCHY
   [IGNOAPS-APL1] Level 1: Block Development Officer (BDO) - within 30 days. First appeal at block level.
   [IGNOAPS-APL2] Level 2: District Social Welfare Officer - within 60 days. Second appeal at district level.
   [IGNOAPS-APL3] Level 3: State Social Welfare Commission - within 90 days. Final appeal at state level.

==============================================================================
END OF GUIDELINE DOCUMENT

GOVERNMENT GUIDELINE DOCUMENT
SCHEME: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
SCHEME ID: IGNWPS-2023
LEVEL: CENTRAL   |   STATE: All India
CATEGORY: PENSION
==============================================================================

1. OBJECTIVE
   Monthly pension for widows aged between 40 and 79 years belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households. Enhanced amount for widows aged 80 years and above.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
   [IGNWPS-C1] (MANDATORY) The applicant must be a widow.
   [IGNWPS-C2] (MANDATORY) The applicant must be 40 years of age or older.
   [IGNWPS-C3] (MANDATORY) The applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household.

3. ENTITLEMENT / BENEFIT RULES
   [IGNWPS-E1] Widows aged 80 years and above receive a pension of Rs. 500 per month.
   [IGNWPS-E2] Widows aged 40 to 79 years receive a pension of Rs. 300 per month.

4. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
   [IGNWPS-D1] (MANDATORY) Death Certificate of Husband
   [IGNWPS-D2] (MANDATORY) BPL Card
   [IGNWPS-D3] (MANDATORY) Aadhaar Card
   [IGNWPS-D4] (MANDATORY) Bank Account Passbook

5. APPLICATION & GRIEVANCE / APPEAL HIERARCHY
   [IGNWPS-APL1] Level 1: Block Development Officer (BDO) - within 30 days. First appeal at block level.
   [IGNWPS-APL2] Level 2: District Social Welfare Officer - within 60 days. Second appeal at district level.
   [IGNWPS-APL3] Level 3: State Social Welfare Commission - within 90 days. Final appeal at state level.

==============================================================================
END OF GUIDELINE DOCUMENT

GOVERNMENT GUIDELINE DOCUMENT
SCHEME: Jal Jeevan Mission
SCHEME ID: JJM-2023
LEVEL: CENTRAL   |   STATE: All India
CATEGORY: WATER
==============================================================================

1. OBJECTIVE
   A mission to provide every rural household with a functional household tap connection supplying adequate and safe drinking water in usable quantity on a regular basis.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
   [JJM-C1] (MANDATORY) The applicant must live in a rural area.

3. ENTITLEMENT / BENEFIT RULES
   [JJM-E1] Every eligible rural household receives an in-kind functional household tap water connection; there is no cash benefit.

4. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
   [JJM-D1] (MANDATORY) Aadhaar Card
   [JJM-D2] (MANDATORY) Address Proof

5. APPLICATION & GRIEVANCE / APPEAL HIERARCHY
   [JJM-APL1] Level 1: Gram Panchayat - within 15 days. First grievance at the village level.
   [JJM-APL2] Level 2: Block Development Officer (BDO) - within 30 days. Escalation at block level.
   [JJM-APL3] Level 3: District Water and Sanitation Mission - within 60 days. Final grievance at district level.

==============================================================================
END OF GUIDELINE DOCUMENT

GOVERNMENT GUIDELINE DOCUMENT
SCHEME: Kisan Credit Card
SCHEME ID: KCC-2023
LEVEL: CENTRAL   |   STATE: All India
CATEGORY: CREDIT
==============================================================================

1. OBJECTIVE
   A credit scheme that gives farmers timely and hassle-free access to institutional credit through a Kisan Credit Card, covering crop cultivation, allied activities and consumption needs.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
   [KCC-C1] (MANDATORY) The applicant must be 18 years of age or older.
   [KCC-C2] (MANDATORY) The applicant must be a farmer.

3. ENTITLEMENT / BENEFIT RULES
   [KCC-E1] An eligible farmer is sanctioned a credit limit of up to Rs. 3 lakh at a concessional interest rate.

4. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
   [KCC-D1] (MANDATORY) Land Records
   [KCC-D2] (MANDATORY) Aadhaar Card
   [KCC-D3] (MANDATORY) Bank Account Passbook

5. APPLICATION & GRIEVANCE / APPEAL HIERARCHY
   [KCC-APL1] Level 1: Bank Branch Manager - within 15 days. First grievance at the bank branch.
   [KCC-APL2] Level 2: Lead District Manager - within 45 days. Escalation at district level.
   [KCC-APL3] Level 3: Banking Ombudsman - within 90 days. Final grievance before the Banking Ombudsman.

==============================================================================
END OF GUIDELINE DOCUMENT

GOVERNMENT GUIDELINE DOCUMENT
SCHEME: Pradhan Mantri POSHAN Shakti Nirman (Mid-Day Meal)
SCHEME ID: MDM-2023
LEVEL: CENTRAL   |   STATE: All India
CATEGORY: NUTRITION
==============================================================================

1. OBJECTIVE
   A school nutrition programme that provides hot cooked meals to children studying in classes one to eight in government and government-aided schools, improving enrolment, attendance and nutrition.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
   [MDM-C1] (MANDATORY) The child must be 6 years of age or older.
   [MDM-C2] (MANDATORY) The child must be 14 years of age or younger.

3. ENTITLEMENT / BENEFIT RULES
   [MDM-E1] Each eligible child receives a free hot cooked meal on every school day; there is no cash benefit.

4. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
   [MDM-D1] (MANDATORY) Aadhaar Card
   [MDM-D2] (MANDATORY) School Enrolment Certificate

5. APPLICATION & GRIEVANCE / APPEAL HIERARCHY
   [MDM-APL1] Level 1: School Headmaster - within 15 days. First grievance at the school level.
   [MDM-APL2] Level 2: Block Education Officer - within 30 days. Escalation at block level.
   [MDM-APL3] Level 3: District Education Officer - within 60 days. Final grievance at district level.

==============================================================================
END OF GUIDELINE DOCUMENT

GOVERNMENT GUIDELINE DOCUMENT
SCHEME: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
SCHEME ID: MGNREGA-2023
LEVEL: CENTRAL   |   STATE: All India
CATEGORY: EMPLOYMENT
==============================================================================

1. OBJECTIVE
   Guarantees at least 100 days of unskilled wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
   [MGNREGA-C1] (MANDATORY) The applicant must be a member of a rural household.
   [MGNREGA-C2] (MANDATORY) The applicant must be an adult (18 years or older) willing to do unskilled manual work.

3. ENTITLEMENT / BENEFIT RULES
   [MGNREGA-E1] Each rural household is guaranteed up to 100 days of wage employment per financial year, paid at the notified daily wage rate.

4. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
   [MGNREGA-D1] (MANDATORY) Job Card
   [MGNREGA-D2] (MANDATORY) Aadhaar Card
   [MGNREGA-D3] (MANDATORY) Bank/Post Office Account Passbook

5. APPLICATION & GRIEVANCE / APPEAL HIERARCHY
   [MGNREGA-APL1] Level 1: Gram Panchayat / Programme Officer - within 15 days. Complaint to the Programme Officer at block level.
   [MGNREGA-APL2] Level 2: District Programme Coordinator - within 30 days. Escalation to the District Programme Coordinator.

==============================================================================
END OF GUIDELINE DOCUMENT

==============================================================================
GOVERNMENT GUIDELINE DOCUMENT
SCHEME: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
SCHEME ID: MUDRA-2023
LEVEL: CENTRAL   |   STATE: All India
CATEGORY: CREDIT
==============================================================================

1. OBJECTIVE
   A scheme that provides collateral-free loans to non-farm micro and small enterprises through banks, NBFCs and microfinance institutions under the Shishu, Kishore and Tarun categories.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
   [MUDRA-C1] (MANDATORY) The applicant must be 18 years of age or older.

3. ENTITLEMENT / BENEFIT RULES
   [MUDRA-E1] Loan limits are tiered: Shishu up to Rs. 50000, Kishore up to Rs. 5 lakh and Tarun up to Rs. 10 lakh, based on the applicant's annual income.

4. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
   [MUDRA-D1] (MANDATORY) Aadhaar Card
   [MUDRA-D2] (MANDATORY) Business Plan
   [MUDRA-D3] (MANDATORY) Bank Account Passbook

5. APPLICATION & GRIEVANCE / APPEAL HIERARCHY
   [MUDRA-APL1] Level 1: Bank Branch Manager - within 15 days. First grievance at the bank branch.
   [MUDRA-APL2] Level 2: Zonal Head - within 45 days. Escalation to the zonal office.
   [MUDRA-APL3] Level 3: Banking Ombudsman - within 90 days. Final grievance before the Banking Ombudsman.

==============================================================================
END OF GUIDELINE DOCUMENT

GOVERNMENT GUIDELINE DOCUMENT
SCHEME: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission
SCHEME ID: NRLM-2023
LEVEL: CENTRAL   |   STATE: All India
CATEGORY: LIVELIHOOD
==============================================================================

1. OBJECTIVE
   A livelihoods mission that organises rural poor households, especially women, into self-help groups and provides capital, credit and skill support to raise household incomes.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
   [NRLM-C1] (MANDATORY) The applicant must live in a rural area.
   [NRLM-C2] (MANDATORY) The applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household.

3. ENTITLEMENT / BENEFIT RULES
   [NRLM-E1] Members organised into self-help groups receive a revolving fund of about Rs. 15000 per group along with bank credit and interest subvention.

4. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
   [NRLM-D1] (MANDATORY) Aadhaar Card
   [NRLM-D2] (MANDATORY) BPL Card
   [NRLM-D3] (MANDATORY) Bank Account Passbook

5. APPLICATION & GRIEVANCE / APPEAL HIERARCHY
   [NRLM-APL1] Level 1: Block Mission Manager - within 30 days. First grievance at the block level.
   [NRLM-APL2] Level 2: District Mission Manager - within 60 days. Escalation at district level.
   [NRLM-APL3] Level 3: State Rural Livelihoods Mission - within 90 days. Final grievance at state level.

==============================================================================
END OF GUIDELINE DOCUMENT

GOVERNMENT GUIDELINE DOCUMENT
SCHEME: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
SCHEME ID: NSP-PREMATRIC-2023
LEVEL: CENTRAL   |   STATE: All India
CATEGORY: SCHOLARSHIP
==============================================================================

1. OBJECTIVE
   Scholarship for SC/ST students studying in Classes 9 and 10, covering admission fees, tuition fees and a monthly maintenance allowance, subject to parental income limits.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
   [NSP-C1] (MANDATORY) The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
   [NSP-C2] (MANDATORY) The applicant must be studying in Class 9 or Class 10.
   [NSP-C3] (MANDATORY) Parental/guardian annual income must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000.

3. ENTITLEMENT / BENEFIT RULES
   [NSP-E1] Hostellers receive a maintenance allowance of Rs. 3,500 per year in addition to fee reimbursement.
   [NSP-E2] Day scholars receive a maintenance allowance of Rs. 7,000 per year including ad-hoc grant.

4. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
   [NSP-D1] (MANDATORY) Caste Certificate (SC/ST)
   [NSP-D2] (MANDATORY) Income Certificate
   [NSP-D3] (MANDATORY) Previous Class Marksheet
   [NSP-D4] (MANDATORY) Bank Account Passbook

5. APPLICATION & GRIEVANCE / APPEAL HIERARCHY
   [NSP-APL1] Level 1: School Scholarship Nodal Officer - within 15 days. First-level grievance at the school/institute.
   [NSP-APL2] Level 2: State Education Department (SC/ST Welfare) - within 45 days. Escalation to the state education welfare department.

==============================================================================
END OF GUIDELINE DOCUMENT

GOVERNMENT GUIDELINE DOCUMENT
SCHEME: Public Distribution System (National Food Security Act, 2013)
SCHEME ID: PDS-NFSA-2023
LEVEL: CENTRAL   |   STATE: All India
CATEGORY: FOOD
==============================================================================

1. OBJECTIVE
   Provides subsidised foodgrains to eligible households through Fair Price Shops under the National Food Security Act, 2013. Priority Households (PHH) and Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) families receive monthly entitlements.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
   [PDS-C1] (MANDATORY) The household must hold a valid ration card classified as either Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) or Priority Household (PHH).
   [PDS-C2] (MANDATORY) The applicant must be a resident of the State/UT where the ration card is issued.
   [PDS-C3] (MANDATORY) A household that pays income tax or is covered under a statutory income-tax category is excluded from Priority Household coverage.

3. ENTITLEMENT / BENEFIT RULES
   [PDS-E1] Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) households receive 35 kg of foodgrains per household per month.
   [PDS-E2] Priority Household (PHH) families receive 5 kg of foodgrains per person per month.

4. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
   [PDS-D1] (MANDATORY) Ration Card
   [PDS-D2] (MANDATORY) Aadhaar Card
   [PDS-D3] (MANDATORY) Residence/Address Proof

5. APPLICATION & GRIEVANCE / APPEAL HIERARCHY
   [PDS-APL1] Level 1: District Supply Officer (DSO) - within 30 days. First appeal against rejection or card correction at the district level.
   [PDS-APL2] Level 2: State Food Commission - within 60 days. Second appeal to the State Food Commission if the district decision is unsatisfactory.

==============================================================================
END OF GUIDELINE DOCUMENT

==============================================================================
GOVERNMENT GUIDELINE DOCUMENT
SCHEME: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
SCHEME ID: PMAYG-2023
LEVEL: CENTRAL   |   STATE: All India
CATEGORY: HOUSING
==============================================================================

1. OBJECTIVE
   Financial assistance for construction of pucca houses with basic amenities for eligible rural households that are houseless or living in kutcha/dilapidated houses.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
   [PMAYG-C1] (MANDATORY) The household must be a rural household without a pucca house (houseless or kutcha house).
   [PMAYG-C2] (MANDATORY) The household must not own a pucca house in any part of the country.
   [PMAYG-C3] (MANDATORY) The household must be included in the SECC 2011 housing deprivation list (or verified by the Gram Sabha).

3. ENTITLEMENT / BENEFIT RULES
   [PMAYG-E1] In plain areas, assistance is Rs. 1,20,000 per unit for house construction.

4. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
   [PMAYG-D1] (MANDATORY) SECC 2011 Registration / Gram Sabha Approval
   [PMAYG-D2] (MANDATORY) Aadhaar Card
   [PMAYG-D3] (MANDATORY) Bank Account Passbook
   [PMAYG-D4] (OPTIONAL) Job Card / Ration Card

5. APPLICATION & GRIEVANCE / APPEAL HIERARCHY
   [PMAYG-APL1] Level 1: Gram Panchayat / Block Development Officer - within 30 days. First-level verification and grievance redressal at the block.
   [PMAYG-APL2] Level 2: District Rural Development Agency (DRDA) - within 60 days. Escalation to the district rural development agency.

==============================================================================
END OF GUIDELINE DOCUMENT

==============================================================================
GOVERNMENT GUIDELINE DOCUMENT
SCHEME: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban)
SCHEME ID: PMAYU-2023
LEVEL: CENTRAL   |   STATE: All India
CATEGORY: HOUSING
==============================================================================

1. OBJECTIVE
   An urban housing mission that provides central assistance and interest subsidy to economically weaker sections and lower income groups to enable them to build or buy a pucca house.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
   [PMAYU-C1] (MANDATORY) The applicant's annual family income must not exceed Rs. 3 lakh.
   [PMAYU-C2] (MANDATORY) The applicant must not already own a pucca house.

3. ENTITLEMENT / BENEFIT RULES
   [PMAYU-E1] An eligible beneficiary receives central assistance of about Rs. 2.67 lakh towards the house.

4. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
   [PMAYU-D1] (MANDATORY) Aadhaar Card
   [PMAYU-D2] (MANDATORY) Income Certificate
   [PMAYU-D3] (MANDATORY) Bank Account Passbook
   [PMAYU-D4] (MANDATORY) Address Proof

5. APPLICATION & GRIEVANCE / APPEAL HIERARCHY
   [PMAYU-APL1] Level 1: Municipal Commissioner - within 30 days. First grievance at the urban local body.
   [PMAYU-APL2] Level 2: State Housing Board - within 60 days. Second grievance at state level.
   [PMAYU-APL3] Level 3: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs - within 90 days. Final grievance at the Ministry.

==============================================================================
END OF GUIDELINE DOCUMENT

==============================================================================
GOVERNMENT GUIDELINE DOCUMENT
SCHEME: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
SCHEME ID: PMEGP-2023
LEVEL: CENTRAL   |   STATE: All India
CATEGORY: EMPLOYMENT
==============================================================================

1. OBJECTIVE
   A credit-linked subsidy programme that supports the setting up of micro-enterprises in manufacturing and service sectors, generating self-employment opportunities in rural and urban areas.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
   [PMEGP-C1] (MANDATORY) The applicant must be 18 years of age or older.

3. ENTITLEMENT / BENEFIT RULES
   [PMEGP-E1] An eligible beneficiary can set up a project with a maximum project cost of Rs. 10 lakh in the service sector.

4. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
   [PMEGP-D1] (MANDATORY) Aadhaar Card
   [PMEGP-D2] (MANDATORY) Project Report
   [PMEGP-D3] (MANDATORY) Bank Account Passbook

5. APPLICATION & GRIEVANCE / APPEAL HIERARCHY
   [PMEGP-APL1] Level 1: KVIC or KVIB District Officer - within 30 days. First grievance at the district office.
   [PMEGP-APL2] Level 2: State Director (KVIC/KVIB) - within 60 days. Escalation at state level.
   [PMEGP-APL3] Level 3: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises - within 90 days. Final grievance at the Ministry.

==============================================================================
